tweaks.name: Turn on Game Mode
tweaks.description: Windows prioritises the game you're playing and holds back updates and background work while it runs.

tweaks.name: Turn off background game recording
tweaks.description: Stops Xbox Game Bar recording gameplay in the background, which costs GPU time every frame. You can still use other recorders like OBS or the NVIDIA app.

tweaks.name: Optimisations for windowed games
tweaks.description: DirectX 10/11 games in windowed and borderless mode use the faster flip presentation model, for lower latency.

tweaks.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.description: The GPU schedules its own memory. Needed for DLSS Frame Generation. Helps on some PCs, does nothing on others.

tweaks.name: High Performance power plan
tweaks.description: The CPU stays at high clocks instead of ramping up when a game needs it. Uses more power, and laptops run warmer.

tweaks.name: Turn off Memory Integrity
tweaks.description: Memory Integrity (Core Isolation) costs about 5% FPS in many games; Microsoft itself suggests turning it off for gaming. It's a security feature, so you lose some protection against malicious drivers.

tweaks.name: Turn off fullscreen optimisations
tweaks.description: Games set to fullscreen run in true exclusive fullscreen. Can lower input lag in older DirectX 9/11 games; on Windows 11 often no difference, and Alt+Tab gets slower. Test it in your games.

tweaks.name: Keep the graphics card's connection awake
tweaks.description: Turns off PCI Express power saving, so the GPU and NVMe drives never wait to wake up their connection. Removes small stutters. Uses a little more power.

tweaks.name: CPU energy preference: maximum performance
tweaks.description: Tells the CPU to favour speed over power saving (Intel 12th gen+ and Ryzen use this to decide how fast to ramp up). Snappier clocks in games, more power and heat at idle.

tweaks.name: Aggressive CPU boost
tweaks.description: Lets the CPU jump to its boost clock as soon as a game asks for it, instead of waiting. Runs a little warmer.

tweaks.name: Stop Game Bar popping up by accident
tweaks.description: The Xbox button on a controller no longer opens the Game Bar overlay mid-game, and its startup tips stop showing.

tweaks.name: Turn off Multiplane Overlay (MPO)
tweaks.description: NVIDIA's own fix for flickering, black screens or stutter when a browser, Discord or a video is open next to a game. Only turn on if you have those problems.

tweaks.name: Variable refresh rate for windowed games
tweaks.description: Lets G-Sync / FreeSync work in borderless and windowed games too (Windows' own 'Variable refresh rate' switch). Smoother and no tearing if your monitor supports it.

tweaks.name: Turn off Virtualization-Based Security
tweaks.description: VBS runs part of Windows inside a virtual machine for security, and Microsoft says it can cost games some FPS. Turning it off gives that back, with less protection against advanced malware. If a game's anti-cheat asks for it, turn this back off.

tweaks.name: Higher priority for games
tweaks.description: Raises the priority Windows' multimedia scheduler gives games (CPU and disk). Only affects games that use the scheduler, so the effect is small, but it's harmless.

tweaks.name: Reserve less CPU for background tasks
tweaks.description: Windows normally holds back 20% of CPU time for background work while media or games run. This lowers it to 10%.

tweaks.name: Turn off power throttling
tweaks.description: Stops Windows slowing down apps in the background, so Discord, OBS and voice chat stay smooth while you play. On laptops, battery drains a bit faster.

tweaks.name: Keep the CPU at full speed when plugged in
tweaks.description: Sets the minimum CPU state to 100% on the current power plan, so it never has to ramp up from idle speed. Uses more power at idle.

tweaks.name: Faster menus
tweaks.description: Menus open after 20 ms instead of 400 ms when you hover over them.

tweaks.name: Turn off notification pop-ups
tweaks.description: Stops Windows notification banners appearing over your game and stealing focus. You can still see them in the notification centre.

tweaks.name: Consistent timer precision for games
tweaks.description: Windows 11 lowers timer precision for apps that aren't in front. This restores the older behaviour, which can steady frame pacing for FPS limiters and overlays. Uses slightly more power.

tweaks.name: Turn off USB 3 power saving
tweaks.description: Stops USB 3 ports dropping into low-power states between inputs, which can add tiny delays to mice, keyboards and headsets plugged into them.

tweaks.name: Turn off mouse acceleration
tweaks.description: Turns off 'Enhance pointer precision', so the same hand movement always moves the cursor the same distance. Essential for consistent aim.

tweaks.name: Set Windows pointer speed to 1:1
tweaks.description: Puts the Windows sensitivity slider on 6/11, the only setting where Windows doesn't skip or add pixels. Set your speed with your mouse's DPI instead. Changes how fast your cursor feels.

tweaks.name: Stop USB devices going to sleep
tweaks.description: Turns off USB selective suspend, so your mouse, keyboard and headset never fall asleep and lag on the first movement or key press.

tweaks.name: Fastest key repeat
tweaks.description: A held key starts repeating sooner and repeats faster. Makes holding keys (backspace, arrows, movement in some games) feel snappier.

tweaks.name: Turn off the Sticky Keys popup
tweaks.description: Pressing Shift five times mid-game no longer pops up Sticky Keys and kicks you out of the game.

tweaks.name: Turn off the Filter Keys popup
tweaks.description: Holding Right Shift for 8 seconds no longer turns on Filter Keys, which ignores quick key presses and adds delay.

tweaks.name: Turn off the Toggle Keys popup
tweaks.description: Holding Num Lock for 5 seconds no longer pops up the Toggle Keys prompt.

tweaks.name: Stop Alt+Shift switching keyboard language
tweaks.description: Alt+Shift and Ctrl+Shift no longer change your keyboard language by accident mid-game. You can still switch with Windows key + Space.

tweaks.name: Turn off window shake
tweaks.description: Shaking a window while dragging it no longer minimises every other window.

tweaks.name: Turn off the Narrator shortcut
tweaks.description: Windows + Ctrl + Enter no longer starts Narrator talking over your game.

tweaks.name: Turn off Mouse Keys and High Contrast shortcuts
tweaks.description: Left Alt + Left Shift + Num Lock (Mouse Keys) and Left Alt + Left Shift + Print Screen (High Contrast) no longer switch on by accident.

tweaks.name: Fortnite: high CPU priority
tweaks.description: Windows always starts Fortnite with high CPU and disk priority, so background apps can't steal time from it. Discord and browsers still run, just at lower priority while Fortnite is open. This is a Windows setting, no game files are changed.

tweaks.name: Counter-Strike 2: high CPU priority
tweaks.description: Windows always starts Counter-Strike 2 with high CPU and disk priority, so background apps can't steal time from it. This is a Windows setting, no game files are changed.

tweaks.name: Rocket League: high CPU priority
tweaks.description: Windows always starts Rocket League with high CPU and disk priority, so background apps can't steal time from it. This is a Windows setting, no game files are changed.

tweaks.name: Wi-Fi: maximum performance
tweaks.description: Turns off Wi-Fi power saving, which can cause ping spikes and lag in online games. No effect if you use a cable.

tweaks.name: Stop uploading updates to other PCs
tweaks.description: Windows stops sharing update files with other PCs over the internet, so it doesn't use your upload while you play.

tweaks.name: Limit background update downloads
tweaks.description: Windows Update can only use 20% of your internet speed while downloading in the background, so it doesn't cause lag or buffering while you play or stream. Updates take a bit longer.

tweaks.name: Encrypt DNS automatically
tweaks.description: Website lookups are encrypted (DNS over HTTPS) when your DNS server supports it, such as Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Google 8.8.8.8 or Quad9. Stops your internet provider seeing which sites you visit. No change with other DNS servers.

tweaks.name: Turn off Energy Efficient Ethernet
tweaks.description: Stops your network card putting the cable connection to sleep between packets. Waking it up can add small ping spikes. Your internet drops for a few seconds while it applies.

tweaks.name: Turn off Green Ethernet and Giga Lite
tweaks.description: Realtek network power-saving features that lower power on the cable and can cause ping spikes. Internet drops for a few seconds while it applies. Only on Realtek cards.

tweaks.name: Turn off network card power saving
tweaks.description: Stops the network card powering down parts of itself when traffic is low, which can cause lag spikes in online games. Internet drops for a few seconds while it applies.

tweaks.name: Turn off interrupt moderation
tweaks.description: The network card hands each packet to the CPU right away instead of grouping them, for the lowest possible network delay. Uses a little more CPU. Internet drops for a few seconds while it applies.

tweaks.name: No surprise restarts from Windows Update
tweaks.description: Windows won't restart on its own to install updates while you're signed in. You restart when it suits you.

tweaks.name: Remove the startup app delay
tweaks.description: Windows waits about 10 seconds after you sign in before starting startup apps. This removes the wait.

tweaks.name: Turn off transparency effects
tweaks.description: Turns off the see-through blur on the taskbar, Start and windows. Saves a little GPU time on weaker PCs.

tweaks.name: Turn off window animations
tweaks.description: Windows open, close and minimise instantly instead of animating. Makes the PC feel faster.

tweaks.name: Stop Store apps running in the background
tweaks.description: Microsoft Store apps can't run when they're closed. Saves memory and CPU. Some of them (Phone Link, Mail, Xbox app) won't send notifications while closed.

tweaks.name: Turn off search indexing
tweaks.description: Stops Windows constantly scanning your files to build the search index, which uses disk and CPU. Searching files in Start and File Explorer gets slower.

tweaks.name: Turn off the print service
tweaks.description: Stops the Print Spooler service. Only turn this on if you never print: printing won't work until you turn it back off.

tweaks.name: Stop Windows Update replacing drivers
tweaks.description: Windows Update stops installing its own (often older) graphics and other drivers over the ones you installed. You update drivers yourself with the NVIDIA app, AMD Adrenalin, etc.

tweaks.name: Faster shutdown
tweaks.description: Windows waits 2 seconds instead of 5 for background services to close when you shut down or restart.

tweaks.name: Turn off hibernation and Fast Startup
tweaks.description: Deletes the hibernation file (often 10 GB or more) and turns off Fast Startup, which can keep drivers in a bad state between restarts. Boot takes a few seconds longer, and laptops can't hibernate.

tweaks.name: Stop hard drives sleeping
tweaks.description: Hard drives no longer spin down, which causes a freeze of a few seconds when they spin back up. No effect on SSDs.

tweaks.name: Clean junk automatically every month
tweaks.description: Turns on Windows Storage Sense: once a month it deletes temporary files apps aren't using. Your own files are never touched.

tweaks.name: Stop writing 'last opened' times
tweaks.description: Windows stops updating every file's 'last accessed' date each time it's read, which saves constant small disk writes. Small speed-up, mostly on hard drives.

tweaks.name: Show file extensions
tweaks.description: Shows .exe, .zip, .pdf etc. on file names, so you can spot fake files like 'photo.jpg.exe'.

tweaks.name: Turn off Remote Assistance
tweaks.description: Nobody can be invited to take control of your PC through Windows Remote Assistance, a common trick in tech-support scams.

tweaks.name: Block adware and junk installers
tweaks.description: Microsoft Defender blocks potentially unwanted apps: bundled toolbars, coin miners, fake optimisers and adware that sneak in with free downloads.

tweaks.name: Turn off AutoPlay for USB drives and discs
tweaks.description: Plugging in a USB stick no longer runs or opens anything by itself, which blocks a common way viruses spread.

tweaks.name: Turn off LLMNR
tweaks.description: Stops an old Windows name lookup that attackers on public Wi-Fi use to steal passwords. Nothing at home depends on it.

tweaks.name: Block script viruses (.vbs, .js)
tweaks.description: Turns off Windows Script Host, so double-clicking a .vbs or .js file from an email or download can't run it. A few old installers and school/work scripts need it.

tweaks.name: 'End task' on the taskbar
tweaks.description: Right-click any app on the taskbar to force-close it, which is handy for a frozen game. No more opening Task Manager. Windows 11 23H2 or newer.

tweaks.name: Alt+Tab shows only windows
tweaks.description: Alt+Tab stops listing every Edge tab, so switching between your game, Discord and the browser is quicker.

tweaks.name: Open File Explorer to 'This PC'
tweaks.description: File Explorer opens on your drives instead of Home, so you get to your files and games faster.

tweaks.name: Turn off SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.description: SysMain preloads apps it expects you to open, which causes disk and memory churn mid-game. On a hard drive, app launches get a little slower.

tweaks.name: Turn off Copilot
tweaks.description: Turns off the Windows Copilot sidebar by policy. On newer builds Copilot is a normal app; uninstall it in Settings > Apps.

tweaks.name: Turn off Widgets
tweaks.description: The news and weather panel stops loading in the background.

tweaks.name: Keep Bing out of Start search
tweaks.description: Start searches your PC and nothing else, so it's faster and never opens a browser by accident.

tweaks.name: Turn off search highlights
tweaks.description: Removes the daily pictures and trending topics from the search box and Start search.

tweaks.name: Turn off Recall
tweaks.description: Stops Windows taking periodic snapshots of your screen on Copilot+ PCs. Does nothing on other machines.

tweaks.name: Stop Edge running when it's closed
tweaks.description: Turns off Startup Boost and background mode. Edge will show 'managed by your organisation' in its settings.

tweaks.name: Stop Windows installing suggested apps
tweaks.description: Windows stops silently installing sponsored apps and games (like Candy Crush) on your PC.

tweaks.name: Turn off tips and suggestions
tweaks.description: No more suggestions in Start, Settings and pop-up tips about Windows features.

tweaks.name: Turn off lock screen ads and fun facts
tweaks.description: Removes the tips, fun facts and promotions shown on the lock screen.

tweaks.name: Stop 'Finish setting up your PC' screens
tweaks.description: Windows stops showing the full-screen 'Let's finish setting up your device' prompts after updates.

tweaks.name: Turn off OneDrive
tweaks.description: Stops OneDrive syncing and running in the background. Only do this if you don't use OneDrive: files in it stop backing up.

tweaks.name: Clean up the Start menu
tweaks.description: Removes promoted apps, tips and Microsoft account reminders from the Start menu's Recommended area.

tweaks.name: Turn off Edge sidebar, shopping and rewards
tweaks.description: Removes Edge's Copilot sidebar, shopping coupon pop-ups and Microsoft Rewards. Edge will show 'managed by your organisation'.

tweaks.name: Turn off ads in File Explorer
tweaks.description: Stops OneDrive and Microsoft 365 promotions appearing at the top of File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Stop feedback pop-ups
tweaks.description: Windows stops asking you to rate it or give feedback.

tweaks.name: Send Microsoft the minimum diagnostic data
tweaks.description: Sets diagnostic data to the lowest level and turns off the Connected User Experiences service that uploads it.

tweaks.name: Turn off the advertising ID
tweaks.description: Apps can't use your advertising ID to show you personalised ads.

tweaks.name: Turn off activity history
tweaks.description: Windows stops recording which apps and files you open and uploading it to Microsoft.

tweaks.name: Turn off error reporting
tweaks.description: Windows stops collecting and sending crash reports, and stops filling your disk with report files.

tweaks.name: Turn off location for all apps
tweaks.description: No app can use your location. Turn it back off if you need maps or 'Find my device'.

tweaks.name: Turn off tailored experiences
tweaks.description: Microsoft stops using your diagnostic data to show you personalised tips, ads and recommendations.

tweaks.name: Turn off online speech recognition
tweaks.description: Your voice isn't sent to Microsoft's servers for recognition. Voice typing and dictation won't work.

tweaks.name: Stop collecting typing and inking data
tweaks.description: Windows stops building a personal dictionary from what you type and write, and stops sending it to Microsoft.

tweaks.name: Hide your language list from websites
tweaks.description: Websites can't read your list of Windows languages, which is used to fingerprint and track you.
